name: Vegetable Soy Tahri
ingredients: ½ cup dry brown basmati rice
Jeera, bay leaf, turmeric and 1 tsp oil
steps: Boil soy chunks, squeeze dry and cut.
Heat oil with jeera and whole spices.
Add vegetables, soy and rice; add water and cook until tender.
note: Measure the rice; brown rice still contributes carbohydrate.
